issues.description: StockIngredient getter naming mismatch: the template class src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java declares a method retrieveQuantity() but the rest of the codebase and the problem statement expect a standard getter named getQuantity(). Specifically, src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java calls stockIngredient.getQuantity(), which will not compile against the template that only provides retrieveQuantity(). The solution implementation and the problem statement use/get the name getQuantity(), so this naming difference is a breaking inconsistency that will confuse students and cause compilation failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide the conventional getter getQuantity() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java so callers compile and the API matches the problem statement and solution. Either rename the existing retrieveQuantity() method to getQuantity(), or add a new public int getQuantity() { return retrieveQuantity(); } method and keep retrieveQuantity() only if needed for backward compatibility. Update any tests or references if necessary.
